budget.justification: Declared structural budget under the plan's equal-budget clause: the cap equals the dimension of the twelve-port source carrier, the only scale the packet supplies (stage-1 basis pin; certificate premise MP1 lists the sectors 1+3+3+5). Every candidate and every alternative is evaluated under this identical cap. Changing the cap is a grammar change that requires a fresh freeze version before any evaluation. The degree-wise exterior tower of the carrier is the natural second budget rung; any comparison there requires its own frozen enumeration before evaluation.

claim_boundary: This document freezes a finite candidate class of graded modules over the classified compact bracket families of the B14 packet. It performs no selection, evaluates no candidate against laboratory data, identifies no laboratory matter multiplet, and closes no deliverable of issue #706 beyond the freeze itself. Every count below is replayed by the validator from the frozen structural data alone.

constraints.statement: Flagged subclass, no membership constraint: weights lie in the sublattice generated by the weights of the source carrier under the certified bracket action. The carrier acts as the adjoint on every derived sector, so this sublattice is the root lattice: odd-dimensional A1 irreps and triality-zero A2 irreps.

constraints.justification: Declared grammar item matching the chirality-grading deliverable of issue #706. Admitting the trivial grading means gradability excludes no module; the grading only refines the count.
constraints.statement: Each candidate carries a Z/2 chirality grading; the trivial grading is admissible; two candidates that differ by the global parity flip are identified.

constraints.justification: The packet contains no receipt deriving a finite anomaly obstruction, so vanishing is recorded as a subclass condition with its own counts rather than imposed. Promotion to membership requires a source receipt and a fresh freeze version.
receipts: declared exact functional; counts in enumeration.per_bracket_type
constraints.statement: Frozen anomaly functionals, no membership constraint: on an A2 irrep with Dynkin label (p,q), the cubic anomaly is A(p,q) = (p-q)(p+2q+3)(2p+q+3)dim(p,q)/60, an integer normalized by A(1,0)=1; the cubic invariant vanishes identically on A1 irreps; abelian and mixed functionals vanish on the class by C3. The graded anomaly sum (even part minus odd part, linear in the multiplicities) and the global Z/2 functional (parity of the number of even-dimensional A1 summands) are frozen observables.
The zero module is excluded; a candidate is nonempty.

decision_rule.equal_budget_clause: Every candidate is evaluated under the identical dimension cap and observable set; no candidate receives extra budget, auxiliary structure, or a tailored observable.
decision_rule.negative_exit_statement: NO-SELECTION is a valid negative exit of B15 and is recorded as a result. Failure to select never licenses weakening the grammar, raising the budget, unbarring an observable, or re-ranking candidates after an evaluation output has been seen.
decision_rule.nonemptiness_clause: A hard-coded candidate that matches a known target proves nonemptiness of the class and never constitutes selection (plan ground rule).
decision_rule.tamper_clause: Any change to the grammar, budget, constraints, observables, or rule after any evaluation output has been seen voids the run; re-evaluation requires a fresh freeze version with a distinct filename and hash.
decision_rule.what_counts_as_source_selection: A deterministic rule whose inputs are limited to (a) the pinned B14 source receipts of this document together with receipts produced by the open issue #705 physical continuation from the same registered source, and (b) the frozen observables of this document evaluated on the frozen candidate list. The rule evaluates every candidate of the class under the same budget and outputs either exactly one pair, a bracket point of the classified compact locus (P, F, or G) together with one candidate module, or NO-SELECTION.

headline_generic_strata.note: Counts at the generic stratum of each classified family. A candidate is a nonempty Z/2-graded module under the frozen constraints, counted up to the global parity flip; the ungraded and anomaly-zero columns are recorded companions, and the carrier-lattice subclass is the flagged C5 refinement.

role: Freeze only. This document fixes the B15 source grammar, candidate class, budget, observables, and decision rule before any comparison, under the plan's no-privilege protocol. The selection lane of issue #706 consumes this document; this artifact performs no selection.

source_grammar.candidate: A candidate is a pair (S, M): S a stratum of the classified compact locus (enumeration.strata) and M a nonempty Z/2-graded finite-dimensional complex module of the complexified semisimple part of the bracket at S, with zero abelian charges (constraint C3) and total dimension at most the budget cap (constraint C1), counted up to graded isomorphism and the global parity flip (constraint C6). The module theory depends only on the stratum's bracket type, so the admissible lists and counts are recorded per bracket type.
source_grammar.stratum_point_ownership: Points inside one stratum carry isomorphic brackets. The choice of the point is owned by the issue #705 source response and enters selection only through pinned source receipts.

source_packet.carrier: Q^12 with A5 sector decomposition 1+3+3+5 (fixed, three_plus, three_minus, five); the bracket lives on the carrier, so the carrier in its adjoint action is the single source-supplied module.

families.F: t_pp_to_p=a, t_ff_to_p=b, t_pf_to_f=-sqrt(5)*a, t_mm_to_m=e, others zero; compact for a nonzero and a*b<0; su(3)+so(3)+R generically
families.G: mirror of F under the swap of the two three-dimensional sectors; compact for a nonzero and a*b>0; su(3)+so(3)+R generically
families.P: closed plane, t_pp_to_p and t_mm_to_m free, all other channels zero; compact at every point; so(3)+so(3)+R^6 generically

source_packet.statement: The B14 certificate classifies the compact real locus of the fourteen-parameter A5-equivariant Jacobi variety on the twelve-port carrier with sector decomposition 1+3+3+5. The locus is the union of exactly three families: the two-parameter plane P of so(3)+so(3) type and the two mirror three-parameter families F and G of su(3)+so(3) type. The certificate supplies exact Killing blocks, derived and center sectors, and fifteen fully certified sample points.
